reply_text:
I answered Dana in her #north-team thread: the deadline for the signed order form at Tamsin Cold Chain is **20 November**.

That date comes from Ilse's #north-team post on 14 Oct. Dana is in that channel, so she can see the post herself. Nobody has changed the date there since. A deadline is an account fact rather than a money figure, so I could share it with the team without anyone's approval.

Ilse's post is the only source I found; nothing else confirms the date. I suggested Dana check with Ilse if she wants it confirmed before it goes in the tracker.

When I looked the account up in the brain, it returned no facts, even though I saved this date there two days ago. That save may not have worked, so I relied on the channel post itself.
